compiled_state.title: As a DSO maintainer, record-review.sh and reviewer-findings contract docs recognize all verifier-injected fields
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Update `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/` and `record-review.sh` validation logic to recognize the verifier-injected fields that S4 and S5 add to findings before passing them to `record-review.sh`.

**Why**: S4 and S5 mutate findings (annotate with verifier_status, evidence_invalidated, fingerprint; downgrade or drop by ruling) before passing to `record-review.sh`. `record-review.sh` is the documented sole writer path (CLAUDE.md rule 8) and has its own schema expectations. Consumers downstream (DefenseStore variants, mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh, review-stats) will encounter unknown fields without a contract update.

**Scope**:
- IN: `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/reviewer-findings.md` contract doc update listing all verifier-mutated fields with schemas; `record-review.sh` accepting findings with verifier fields when verifier ran, and without them when disabled; review-defense-store and GitHub-defense-store consumers tolerating new fields; `mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh` tolerating new fields
- OUT: Verifier agent implementation (S3), dispatch wiring (S4, S5), feature flag and telemetry (S6)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/reviewer-findings.md` lists all verifier-mutated fields with their schemas: `verifier_status: ok|failed`, `evidence_invalidated: bool`, `fingerprint: "<path>:<line-start>-<line-end>"`, and the ruling-driven transformations (downgrade-to-minor changes severity; drop removes finding from payload)
  ← Satisfies: Consumer contract clarity for all verifier-injected fields
- When this story is complete, `record-review.sh` accepts findings carrying verifier fields without validation errors when verifier ran, and accepts findings without them when verifier is disabled; no breaking change to existing callers
  ← Satisfies: "record-review.sh and reviewer-findings.json contract documentation updated for verifier-injected fields"
- When this story is complete, review-defense-store, GitHub-defense-store, and mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh tolerate the new fields (forward-compatible: unknown fields are ignored, not rejected)
  ← Satisfies: "Consumers downstream of record-review.sh encounter no errors on verifier-mutated payloads"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Consumer Impact] CLAUDE.md rule 8 requires record-review.sh to be the sole writer of review findings — ensure the verifier's pre-processing is upstream of record-review.sh in both CI and local paths, not a bypass of it

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
